journey.name: AX-01 Every icon-only control carries a description
journey.description:
Covers NFR-09, which backlog task TB-308 verified by reading the code rather than by running anything. An icon-only control with no content description is invisible to TalkBack and unreachable by any assistive navigation.
The decorative search icon is deliberately null (TaskListScreen.kt:192) and must stay that way - announcing it would be noise, not access.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that an element with the content description "Add task" is on screen
Verify that an element with the content description "Sort tasks" is on screen
Verify that every task row has an element with the content description "Delete task"
Verify that every task row has a checkbox with a content description
Type "e" into the "Search by title" field
Verify that an element with the content description "Clear search" is on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Clear search"
Verify that an element with the content description "Back" is on screen
